says: Last version of the leap. The scout is half again as large, with a brow, a set mouth and a jaw line, gloved mitts with cuffs and thumbs instead of balls, and everything loose streams back against the leap: a long two-tailed scarf and the flapping ends of her pack straps. The cloud bank is now long thin horizontal bands with only a few broken bumps on top and stipple settling beneath. The island undersides are blockier, lumpy chunks rather than cones, and each one trails a detached fragment or two of rock hanging below it.
